prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a low-speed head-on collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1153; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the injured party in connection with the motor vehicle collision described above. Our client sustained injuries in a low-speed head-on collision and is entitled to full compensation under the applicable coverages. Please direct all further communications regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, either by telephone or in writing.

We request that you provide the bodily injury liability policy limits applicable to the insured driver, along with a certified copy of the declarations page and any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. Please also confirm the claim number assigned to this matter and the name of the adjuster handling it.

Your insured is obligated to preserve all evidence relating to this collision. This includes vehicle data and event data recorder information, photographs, dashcam or telematics footage, repair estimates, total loss valuations, recorded statements, claim file notes, and all correspondence. We ask that you issue a litigation hold to the appropriate parties and confirm in writing that these materials will be preserved.

We look forward to your prompt response within fourteen days of the date of this letter.
